McDonald's Collection 2021

Released February 9, 2021 · 25 cards

Expanded

McDonald's Collection 2021 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on February 9, 2021. It has 25 cards. It includes 25 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
